title: Telegram bot
description: A separate channel for your notifications, exports and reports.
unavailable: The integration is ready, but the administrator has not configured the bot yet. Website features work independently.
connectDescription: The link is confirmed in two steps. Entering a Telegram ID manually cannot connect an account.
stepOne: Create a personal, short-lived link below. Do not share it.
stepTwo: Open the bot using the link and press Start.
stepThree: Return here, check your Telegram ID and confirm the connection.
waiting: Waiting for confirmation in Telegram. The status updates automatically. If you lost the link or it expired, create a new one.
confirmDescription: Telegram account waiting to be linked:
confirmWarning: Confirm only if this is your Telegram account. After confirmation it can access your exports and reports.
preferencesDescription: Choose which messages can be sent to your private chat.
notificationsHint: Account sign-ins, security events and subscription updates.
exportsHint: Send completed parser exports as Excel and newly generated reports as HTML. Manual download from the bot menu stays available when this is off.
broadcastsHint: Opt in to updates and events sent by the administrator.
privacy: Sending a file creates a copy in Telegram. Website retention limits apply to the original, not to the copy already delivered to your chat.
disconnectWarning: Stop future deliveries and remove the account link? Messages already sent will remain in Telegram.
webappHint: Open the website inside Telegram using the bot's WebApp button. Your normal website sign-in and two-factor authentication still apply.
error: Could not complete the request. Check your session and try again.
